attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Mississippi corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($250K gross receipts); result.ms_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ms_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Mississippi state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Mississippi state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ms_state_additions = 0.0; if result.ms_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.ms_state_additions = result.ms_state_additions + result.ms_us_interest_income; endif set result.ms_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.ms_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.ms_state_subtractions = result.ms_state_subtractions + result.ms_municipal_interest; endif add (("Mississippi additions: $" + string value of (result.ms_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.ms_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.ms_state_additions xdef { result.ms_state_additions result.ms_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.ms_state_additions xdef } {} result.ms_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.ms_state_subtractions xdef { result.ms_state_subtractions result.ms_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.ms_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ms_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Mississippi additions: $" result.ms_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.ms_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Mississippi corporate income tax. Applies graduated rates (3%, 4%, 5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ms_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Mississippi corporate tax (graduated rates 3%, 4%, 5%); Apply Mississippi graduated rates
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ms_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ms_apportioned_income + result.ms_state_additions - result.ms_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.ms_tier1_tax = (the minimum of (result.ms_taxable_income) and (5000.0)) * result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier1; set result.ms_tier2_tax = 0.0; set result.ms_tier3_tax = 0.0; if result.ms_taxable_income > 5000.0 then set result.ms_tier2_tax = ((the minimum of (result.ms_taxable_income) and (10000.0)) - 5000.0) * result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier2; endif if result.ms_taxable_income > 10000.0 then set result.ms_tier3_tax = (result.ms_taxable_income - 10000.0) * result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier3; endif set result.ms_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.ms_tier1_tax + result.ms_tier2_tax + result.ms_tier3_tax - result.ms_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.ms_refund_or_owed = result.ms_estimated_payments - result.ms_tax_liability; add "Mississippi taxable income: $" + string value of (result.ms_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Mississippi tax liability (graduated rates 3%-5%): $" + string value of (result.ms_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.ms_apportioned_income result.ms_state_additions f+ result.ms_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ms_taxable_income xdef result.ms_taxable_income 5000.0 fmin result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier1 fmul cvd /result.ms_tier1_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.ms_tier2_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.ms_tier3_tax xdef { result.ms_taxable_income 10000.0 fmin 5000.0 f- result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier2 fmul cvd /result.ms_tier2_tax xdef } {} result.ms_taxable_income 5000.0 f> ifelse { result.ms_taxable_income 10000.0 f- result.ms_corp_tax_rate_tier3 fmul cvd /result.ms_tier3_tax xdef } {} result.ms_taxable_income 10000.0 f> ifelse result.ms_tier1_tax result.ms_tier2_tax result.ms_tier3_tax result.ms_state_credits f- f+ f+ 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ms_tax_liability xdef result.ms_estimated_payments result.ms_tax_liability f- cvd /result.ms_refund_or_owed xdef "Mississippi taxable income: $" result.ms_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Mississippi tax liability (graduated rates 3%-5%): $" result.ms_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
